blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Aims to reduce urban poverty and create employment by providing financial assistance and skill
development to the urban poor, SHGs, and small businesses.
 Eligibility: Cities with populations over 1 lakh.
 Support: Loans of ₹2 lakh per member (max ₹10 lakh/SHG) and ₹2 lakh for individual
 Additional Benefits: Skill training, shelters for the homeless, and support for street vendors.
